title: 56-year-old chestnut grove, one of America’s last, at risk from AI data center
content: In West Virginia, plans for a new data center, the Monarch Compute Campus, could mean the removal of around 200 blight-resistant American chestnut trees. Planted in the 1970s, these trees are vital for future restoration projects. Conservationists express concern over the potential loss of this endangered genetic resource, making its fate precarious amidst development considerations and the push for sustainability.

title: Meet Gabriella Rothberg, 17, co-inventor of patented genetically engineered tomato

Now 17, she is listed alongside her father on a US patent issued in June 2026. The project remains experimental, with taste and nutritional benefits yet to be established.

title: ‘Too old’ to Asian Games MMA medallist: Suchika Tariyal’s journey from judo to glory
content: At 36, after years of setbacks, selection hurdles and changing sports, Suchika Tariyal finally has the Asian Games medal she had chased since childhood. India’s first Asian Games MMA medallist came within 700 grams of a place in the final at Aichi-Nagoya. From an eight-time national judo champion to a ju-jitsu world champion, Tariyal’s journey has been shaped by financial strain, doubts over her age and her husband Kapil Hooda’s unwavering faith.

title: Kansas couple builds 100,000-gallon lagoon in backyard

Their captivating project drew attention online, leading to requests for exclusive photo sessions and events, while they relish their private backyard oasis as they finalize the landscaping.

Over 24 months, the project recorded significant increases in pollinator species and bee visitation. Engaging local communities, Buzzing Blooms focuses on inclusive outdoor spaces catering to diverse needs. Through workshops and advocacy, Kaur aims to foster environmental action among youth.

title: "I only drink on weekends": Can occasional drinking still damage the liver even without any symptoms?
content: Regular weekend drinking might feel harmless, but it can severely compromise your liver health. The liver, tasked with processing alcohol, may incur cellular damage and cause inflammation over time. Persistent episodes of binge drinking can lead to conditions like fatty liver disease, which often shows no symptoms. Without attention, this damage could escalate to fibrosis or cirrhosis, impairing liver function and overall well-being.

A relationship thrives on accountability, fostering awareness of recurring patterns. Although trust and forgiveness are vital components, they should never excuse ongoing disrespect or lack of integrity.

title: No reservation for OBC, Dalits who convert: SC
content: a Scheduled Castes/OBC person who converts from a Hindu social order will not be entitled to the benefits of reservation . the court held that reservation is attached to a constitutionally identified class and not to an individual as a personal entitlement .

title: Migrants taking four in five new jobs in Britain; Indians largest foreign workforce
content: just one in five (734,000) of the 3.7 million additional payroll jobs created in Britain between 2014 and 2025 went to British nationals, a report by the centre for social justice reveals . a think tank studies the root causes of Britain’s social problems found that EU nationals accounted for 408,000 of these jobs . those held by non-EU nationals increased by 2.5 million .

title: Panel seeks citizens' inputs on 'unnatural' demographic shifts
content: the high-level committee has sought individual citizens' inputs on major demographic changes . individual responders can provide causes of demographic changes, as perceived by them . they have been further told to specify the challenges arising due to demographic change .

title: PM Modi to visit Canada on December 11-12 as India, Ottawa push to boost ties
content: the announcement follows a telephone conversation between PM Modi and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney . the two leaders agreed to build on the positive momentum in relations and pursue concrete outcomes . both countries seek to strengthen bilateral ties and advance cooperation across key sectors .

title: 'We’re done': Zelenskyy defies Trump, says will keep hitting Russian refineries
content: "the block [on attacking refineries] is out. We’re done," says Zelenskyy . he expressed anger over withdrawal of US intelligence support and disruptions to Starlink satellite internet service . more than 100 civilians have been killed in Russian attacks over the past week .

title: 'Ready to be detained': Dipke defiant ahead of Tiranga march in Delhi
content: dipke questioned the decision to shut the park, saying the authorities could not close every location where the outfit might organise a demonstration . he said police personnel were keeping him under surveillance and said he could be detained overnight or on Friday morning . dipke was prepared to go to jail for waving the Tricolour as the outfit called on supporters to gather at Central Park on Friday .

title: Uttarakhand minister files FIR against husband, alleges assault, plot to kill her
content: a woman empowerment and child development minister lodged an FIR against her husband, Pappu Girdhari, at police station . she said she married him in bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, on July 6, 2004 and alleged he had deceived her by claiming to be unmarried despite having a wife and children .

title: If every citizen becomes a journalist, it will create problems for all, says SC
content: the suprem court says it will be problematic if every citizen becomes a journalist . a senior advocate complained to a bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi . there must be a national protocol for police not to obstruct the work of any journalist who has an identity card from the employer .

title: SC issues notices to CEC, ECs on INDIA bloc SIR petition
content: a petition filed by inDIA bloc functionaries led by Rahul Gandhi alleges irregularities in SIR, arbitrary deletion of voters, undemocratic functioning of the poll panel and flaws in EVM use . a bench of CJI Surya Kant and Justice Joymalya Bagchi said it was issuing notices on the petition and would await the responses .

title: 3 children, teacher killed in US school shooting; 16-year-old shooter found dead
content: the 16-year-old shooter was found dead inside the school, police say . a community member pursued the shooter into the school and shot him . police received a 911 call at 12.59pm reporting that an unknown man had fired a shot into a car outside the school .
